card.name: Words before a state or condition
card.fires_on: Short linking words (remain, be, co, of, those, Patients) right before a predicted status or condition, such as protected, HIV-negative, infected, or loss of protection.

modes.label: Remain / be before a status
modes.description: Verbs like remain or be that lead into a status word such as protected or HIV-negative.

modes.label: Co- before infected
modes.description: The start of co-infected in descriptions of patients with two infections.
